typography.display: Outfit (Weights: 600, 700, 800) - Used for primary headings and hero text
typography.body: Inter (Weights: 400, 500) - Used for paragraphs, general UI text
typography.mono: JetBrains Mono (Weights: 500, 600) - Used for data, timers, scores, section tags, and coding editor

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(10,10,10,0.1), unverified companies use 2px dashed #FF6F4D
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used selectively on sticky nav - backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAF8F3]/80 border-b border-[rgba(10,10,10,0.05)]
visual_enhancers.radius: xl (16px) for main cards, md (8px) for chips and buttons. Nested radii rule applies.

components.pipeline_diagram: 4 connected nodes (Resume -> OA -> Interview -> Review) with an animated flowing SVG connector. Color-coded nodes.
components.company_card: Shows time-limit chip, 3-4 'what to expect' chips. Unverified get dashed border + red badge.
components.coding_ide: Split-panel layout. Left: problem + test cases (light theme). Right: dark code editor (#0F111A).
components.buttons: Pill-shaped, bold primary background (#0FAE73) with white text, micro-interactions on hover.

grids_layouts.landing_page: header -> hero (rating badge, gradient text, CTA, avatars) -> contrarian statement -> feature grid (Bento A: 1 dark hero card, 2 light cards) -> live preview mockup -> company grid (auto-fit minmax) -> pricing -> FAQ
grids_layouts.company_grid: Dense grid for 14 companies. gap-6, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4
grids_layouts.coding_layout: CSS Grid, 100vh height. grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2. Left side scrollable, right side fixed editor.
grids_layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B). sidebar left, content right. Cardless rectangular surfaces.

motion.pipeline: Framer motion for glowing flowing stroke along SVG path between nodes.
motion.cards: Subtle -translate-y-1 and shadow increase on hover.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #0A0A0A text on #FAF8F3 background. #FFFFFF text on #0FAE73 buttons. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-hidden for decorative pipeline nodes.
accessibility.data_testid: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.

media.icons: lucide-react for UI icons, react-icons for company logos (e.g., SiMicrosoft, SiIbm) - install react-icons

3d_libraries.recommendation: Framer Motion for pipeline animation. Avoid heavy 3D to keep the UI fast and focus on the SaaS functional clarity.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use specific fonts: Outfit, Inter, JetBrains Mono.
Implement the landing page in /app/frontend/src/App.js or equivalent main file, without Shadcn UI layout wrappers (use raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing asymmetry).
For dashboard and authenticated routes, utilize Shadcn UI components heavily customized with the SaaS theme colors.
Pipeline Animation: Create an SVG path connecting 4 div nodes. Use framer-motion to animate a stroke-dashoffset or stroke-dasharray over the path to simulate a flowing connector.
Coding Round Layout: Ensure split pane. Force dark mode styles on the right-side pane only, regardless of global light theme.
Feature Grid: One large dark hero card (e.g., bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white), and two light cards to create contrast.
Company Grid: Map through the 14 companies. Implement a visual flag (dashed border + red badge) for unverified companies.
Install react-icons for company logos: yarn add react-icons
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic, on-distribution AI slop. Be distinctive.
Do not center align the app container in App.css.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Incorporate subtle noise overlays or grain textures where appropriate to break flatness.
Always use the provided image URLs or react-icons for logos. Do NOT use placeholder text.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
